info.desc: Different Class (released in Japan as "Common People") is the fifth studio album by English rock band Pulp. In 2013, NME ranked the album at number six in its list of the 500 greatest albums of all time. Released by Island Records on 30 October 1995 at the height of Britpop, the album led to the band being regarded by some as part of that movement. Two of the singles on the album – "Common People" (which reached number two in the UK singles chart) and "Disco 2000" (which reached number seven) – were especially notable, and helped propel Pulp .
